newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CORNICK BUYS BEDDING FIRM FOR 22 MLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: CORNICK BUYS BEDDING FIRM FOR 22 MLN RAND.

text.p: Pat Cornick Ltd said on Wednesday it had bought the business of the Future Bedding Group with effect from March 1, 1997 for 22 million rand.
It said the purchase of the operation, which manufactures and distributes household bedding and related products, would be settled by the issue and allotment two tranches of linked units.
The first batch would see 750,000 linked units allotted at an issue price of 20 rand per unit.

This would be followed within six months by a further 350,000 linked units also at 20 rand but subject to the Future Bedding earning profits before tax and decentralisation benefits of not less than 5.2 million in respect of the year ended September 30, 1997.
Cornick said the acquisition was in line with its objective to expand and diversify its trading activities.
